mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_group_key_wrap (group_id, user_id, key_version, wrapped_key, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{keyVersion}, #{wrappedKey}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (group_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET key_version = EXCLUDED.key_version, wrapped_key = EXCLUDED.wrapped_key, updated_at = NOW()
